commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' 26:74 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Ridle Baku is replaced by Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig).
89' A yellow card for a tackle by Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim). Tobias Stieler doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
86' A mid-range free kick is awarded to RB Leipzig out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
84' The substitution has been made. Julian Niehues (Heidenheim) has replaced Jan Schoppner.
82' The Heidenheim players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andrija Maksimovic (RB Leipzig) comes onto the pitch for El Chadaille Bitshiabu.
77' Ole Werner has decided to make a change. Max Finkgrafe (RB Leipzig) replaces David Raum.
77' The manager makes a subsitution with Hennes Behrens (Heidenheim) coming on for Mathias Honsak.
77' Here comes a substitution. Luca Kerber (Heidenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Marvin Pieringer.
76' The RB Leipzig players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
72' That's the end of the game for Christoph Baumgartner, who is replaced by Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig).
71' Ole Werner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig) replacing Antonio Nusa.

70' 0 - 3 Goal! Yan Diomande plays in David Raum (RB Leipzig), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box he shoots into the top of the net! Great finish - 0:3.

68' 0 - 2 An amazing individual effort from Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom left corner and makes it 0:2. Diant Ramaj was helpless.
65' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
65' The linesman makes the right call and Heidenheim will have a corner.
63' Substitution. Arijon Ibrahimovic makes way for Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim).
63' Frank Schmidt decides to make a substitution. Adrian Beck will be replaced by Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim).
62' 0 - 1 Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Diant Ramaj with a strike into the top left corner. He makes it 0:1.
61' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
59' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
58' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) tackles a bit over-zealously and Tobias Stieler blows for a foul.
55' Heidenheim have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
53' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) attempts to head the rebound into the roof of the net, but Diant Ramaj reads his intention and makes an incredible reflex save!
53' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
52' The RB Leipzig players are exchanging some short passes.
50' A goal, which was scored by Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig), was disallowed due to offside.
50' David Raum (RB Leipzig) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
48' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.

46' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches over the bar. He should have scored!
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The ball is cleared after Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
45' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

44' RB Leipzig slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
42' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) commits a rough challenge and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
39' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
37' A pass by Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
36' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
35' Referee Tobias Stieler signals NO PENALTY for RB Leipzig after a VAR review!
33' Surely that's handball by one of the Heidenheim players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
31' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from RB Leipzig.
30' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
29' RB Leipzig control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

27' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
27' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
25' The game is interrupted. Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
25' Diant Ramaj (Heidenheim) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
24' The free kick from long range, taken by RB Leipzig, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

22' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
21' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Peter Gulacsi pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
20' The resulting corner from Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
20' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee points to the corner flag and Heidenheim will take a corner.
19' RB Leipzig seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

17' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The ball is out of play. Heidenheim will take a throw-in.
16' RB Leipzig couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Diant Ramaj (Heidenheim) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
16' Leonidas Stergiou (Heidenheim) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. RB Leipzig are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

13' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) meets a cross inside the penalty area and unloads a good attempt towards the right side of the goal. Peter Gulacsi is prepared, though, and denies him with a fantastic save.
12' The foul by Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) was seen by Tobias Stieler who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
12' El Chadaille Bitshiabu (RB Leipzig) sends an accurate short pass. Willi Orban controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
11' Great teamplay by Heidenheim as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
9' The referee blows his whistle as Leonidas Stergiou (Heidenheim) was too aggressive in his challenge.
9' The Heidenheim players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
8' RB Leipzig seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
7' Leonidas Stergiou (Heidenheim) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
7' Heidenheim take a short corner kick.
6' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) bursts into the box and latches on to a pin-point long through ball, but one of the defenders steps in to clear the ball to safety.
6' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
4' A great pass puts Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hits his shot against the left post.
3' RB Leipzig are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
1' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
1' The first half has just begun.
